title: After local election defeats, OpenAI seeks community support
teaser: After voters in the US rejected new data centers in 40 of 41 local votes, OpenAI introduced voluntary rules for its own future sites. The company promises to pay for electricity and grid upgrades, reduce consumption at peak times, and disclose information about construction, noise and water use. OpenAI is also urging lawmakers to make such requirements mandatory across the industry. But it remains unclear how widely they will apply: partners such as Oracle build and operate a significant share of the company’s infrastructure.
